The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `18888` (see `AspireDashboardBuilder.AspireDashboardHttpPort`)
- Port: `18889` (see `AspireDashboardBuilder.AspireDashboardOtlpGrpcPort`)
- Port: `18890` (see `AspireDashboardBuilder.AspireDashboardOtlpHttpPort`)
- Environment variable: `DOTNET_DASHBOARD_UNSECURED_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS=true`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /` to port `18888` is completed successfully.
